title: The work order lines bulk bar is unchanged and its X shows Clear selection
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an open work order for this test, with two lines.
  • Have screenshots of the work order lines bulk bar from the build before this one, in the light and the dark theme, so the bar can be compared.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Start on that work order's Lines tab.
custom_steps:
1. Tick the checkbox of the first line.
  2. Tick the checkbox of the second line.
  3. Hover over the X at the right end of the bar.
  4. Click your avatar at the top right.
  5. Click Dark.
  6. Click your avatar at the top right again.
  7. Click Light.
  8. Click the X at the right end of the bar.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A bulk bar appears, with a round badge reading 1.

Step 2:

  • The badge reads 2, followed by "selected".
  • The bar's colours, buttons and their order match the light-theme screenshot from the earlier build.

Step 3:

  • A hover text reading "Clear selection" appears (this hover text is new on this build).

Step 4:

  • The avatar menu opens.

Step 5:

  • The bar's colours and text match the dark-theme screenshot from the earlier build.

Step 6:

  • The avatar menu opens.

Step 7:

  • The bar is back in the light theme.

Step 8:

  • The bar disappears and both lines are unticked.
